You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-working-today-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-guide-2|everything]] breaks down. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This post outlines how to effectively sell design assets using crypto payments without relying on conventional platforms. Many digital creators are locked out of mainstream payment processors that charge high fees or are simply unavailable in certain countries. By adopting a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you harness the power of crypto payments through NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction. This significant reduction in fees allows you to maximize your profits while maintaining full control over your sales process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components that work together seamlessly. You start with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your online store. For the backend logic, you can utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which are both free and highly effective. Order storage can be managed with Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing you to keep track of sales efficiently. Finally, you use NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring that payments are verified instantly and securely. This architecture provides a robust framework for selling digital products without the dependency on restrictive platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are either unavailable or impose prohibitive fees. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other design assets, this model empowers you to collect payments in cryptocurrency while keeping more of your revenue. It's especially beneficial for creators in countries facing economic instability or currency depreciation, allowing you to retain value and maintain sovereignty over your income.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings instead of paying high fees to platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The framework comprises several essential components that integrate to create a fully functional online storefront. First, the hosting solution (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages) provides a reliable space for your products. The backend logic, implemented via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handles the processing of orders. For data management, tools like Supabase or Google Sheets keep track of your inventory and sales data. The crowning component, NOWPayments, ensures that cryptocurrency transactions are smooth, with instant payment confirmations and minimal fees. Together, these elements form a cohesive system that supports your digital sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting solution between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage your product listings and order processing. Set up your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets to keep organized records of your sales. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. Once everything is in place, you can launch your online store and start selling your design assets effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce infrastructure that accepts crypto payments. By leveraging tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you can create an efficient sales platform without relying on conventional payment processors. This setup significantly reduces fees, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
Leverage crypto payments to bypass region-specific restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

The best way is to use a decentralized infrastructure that allows you to own your sales process. By using NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can minimize fees significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store. Using a combination of GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can create a fully functional sales platform without relying on traditional marketplaces.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide audience. This includes popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, providing flexibility for your customers.
How does NOWPayments compare to traditional payment processors?

NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. This difference retains more of your earnings, especially as your sales volume increases.
